newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita to combine PC operations in new firm.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita to combine PC operations in new firm.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co said on Friday it would combine its operations related to personal computers into a new group company, Panasonic Computer Co, to respond more quickly to market demands.
Matsushita expects the new company, to be formed on February 1, to post sales of 40 billion yen in the year starting on April 1 and 100 billion yen the following year.
The reorganisation is part of Matsushita's "Development 2000" mid-term business plan, which aims to accelerate the company's shift into the multimedia business, it said.
